# Decision-sensitivity results (generated by decision_sensitivity.py)

Parameters: params.yaml (as of 2026-09-29). All figures CAD nominal, illustrative.

## Example 1 - Industrial process heat pump (2 MWth, retrofit)

Capex $3.5M; gas avoided 50,824 GJ/yr (~2,541 tCO2e/yr on site); electricity added 4,000 MWh/yr; 20-yr life; 8% nominal discount; taxable corporation.

NPV in $M. Carbon regimes: *none* = site below industrial thresholds; *market* = covered facility valued at credit-market price (AB with 2030+ floor); *headline* = covered facility valued at the benchmark price (the common shortcut). QC cap-and-trade applies to all gas users.

| Prov | ITC | none | market | headline | IRR (market) | Payback yrs (market) | Breakeven flat $/t |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QC | yes | +0.70 | +0.70 | +0.70 | 11.5% | 7.9 | 31 |
| QC | no | -0.13 | -0.13 | -0.13 | 7.5% | 10.5 | 76 |
| ON | yes | -4.22 | -2.44 | -1.99 | n/a | >life | 230 |
| ON | no | -5.05 | -3.27 | -2.82 | n/a | >life | 276 |
| AB | yes | -3.41 | -2.11 | -1.07 | -7.7% | >life | 177 |
| AB | no | -4.24 | -2.93 | -1.90 | -8.4% | >life | 221 |
| BC | yes | -0.85 | +0.66 | +1.37 | 11.5% | 7.6 | 47 |
| BC | no | -1.68 | -0.17 | +0.54 | 7.3% | 10.2 | 92 |
| NS | yes | +1.65 | +2.51 | +3.81 | 19.8% | 4.6 | -93 |
| NS | no | +0.82 | +1.68 | +2.98 | 14.0% | 6.6 | -46 |

**Decision flips detected:**

- QC (covered, market): ITC eligibility flips decision
- BC (ITC yes): coverage status flips decision (not covered NO-GO vs covered GO)
- BC (ITC no): headline says GO, market-price says NO-GO
- BC (covered, market): ITC eligibility flips decision

**Net emissions effect (on-site avoided minus added grid emissions, average grid factor):**

| Prov | On-site t/yr avoided | Grid t/yr added | Net t/yr | Net as % of on-site |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| QC | 2,541 | 10 | 2,531 | 100% |
| ON | 2,541 | 295 | 2,246 | 88% |
| AB | 2,541 | 1,340 | 1,201 | 47% |
| BC | 2,541 | 91 | 2,450 | 96% |
| NS | 2,541 | 2,112 | 429 | 17% |

Ontario at a marginal (gas-fired) factor of ~450 g/kWh: grid adds 1,800 t/yr, net 741 t/yr (29% of on-site).

Incremental capex $0.75M (HP $0.90M vs gas boiler $0.15M); 3,060 GJ useful heat/yr; SCOP 2.5; medium-power electricity tariff; commercial gas = industrial + $2/GJ; no industrial carbon price (below thresholds) except QC cap-and-trade embedded in gas.

| Prov | Taxable owner + CT ITC NPV $M | Taxable, ITC denied NPV $M | Tax-exempt owner (hospital/university/municipal) NPV $M |

| BC | -0.37 | -0.57 | -0.69 |
| NS | -0.26 | -0.46 | -0.55 | 

## Example 3 - Large Alberta emitter: which carbon-value assumption clears the hurdle?

Generic abatement project at an AB TIER facility: abates 50 kt/yr for 20 years, +$1.0M/yr net opex, taxable (23%), immediate expensing assumed, no ITC. Capex is swept to cover projects from cheap to expensive abatement. Carbon value = credits generated/avoided x price.

| Capex $M | Breakeven flat $/t | Headline NPV $M | Market $20, no floor NPV $M | Market + 2030 floor NPV $M | CCfD $85 to 2040 NPV $M | Decision spread |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 | 54 | +25.51 | -12.99 | +5.08 | +13.87 | FLIPS: GO only under Headline, Market + 2030 floor, CCfD $85 to 2040 |
| 25 | 75 | +17.63 | -20.86 | -2.79 | +6.00 | FLIPS: GO only under Headline, CCfD $85 to 2040 |
| 35 | 96 | +9.76 | -28.73 | -10.66 | -1.87 | FLIPS: GO only under Headline |
| 45 | 117 | +1.89 | -36.60 | -18.53 | -9.74 | FLIPS: GO only under Headline |
| 60 | 148 | -9.91 | -48.40 | -30.33 | -21.54 | all NO-GO |

Levelized (flat-equivalent at 8%) carbon value of each assumption: Headline $122/t; Market $20, no floor $20/t; Market + 2030 floor $68/t; CCfD $85 to 2040 $91/t.
The carbon-value assumption decides the investment for any project whose breakeven lies between $20 and $122/t. A CCfD (vs merchant credits with the announced floor) decides it between $68 and $91/t. 

## Tornado - what moves the NPV most? (Example 1, Ontario, covered facility, market carbon, ITC granted)

Base NPV -2.44 $M.

| Driver | Low case NPV $M | High case NPV $M | Swing $M |
|---|---|---|---|
| Carbon: not covered ($0) / headline | -4.22 | -1.99 | 2.23 |
| Electricity price +20% / -20% (incl. Class A vs B) | -3.29 | -1.58 | 1.71 |
| Gas price -30% / +30% | -3.14 | -1.74 | 1.40 |
| CT ITC + expensing: denied / granted | -3.27 | -2.44 | 0.83 |
| Capex +30% / -10% | -3.05 | -2.23 | 0.81 |
| Discount rate 10% / 6% | -2.41 | -2.48 | 0.07 |

## Monte Carlo - policy-regime and price uncertainty (illustrative probabilities)

n = 20,000 draws, seed 20260929. Persistent log-normal shocks: gas sigma 0.30, electricity 0.15, credit price sigma 0.35; capex overrun triangular(-10%, 0, +30%); CT-ITC eligibility for a process heat pump is case-by-case, modelled as p(eligible)=0.6.

- QC regimes: cap-and-trade continues (+5%/yr) p=0.85; market breakdown to $30 from 2029 p=0.15
- BC regimes: credits at 68% of headline p=0.60; oversupply to 40% p=0.30; OBPS repealed from 2029 p=0.10
- AB regimes: floor as announced p=0.55; floor at half strength p=0.30; policy rollback (market $15, no floor) p=0.15. Shock applies to the $20 market price; floor applied after.
- ON regimes: EPU at 80% of headline p=0.60; oversupply to 45% p=0.30; EPS repealed from 2029 p=0.10

**Full uncertainty** (policy regimes + energy prices + capex skew (mean 1.067) + ITC eligibility p=0.6):

| Case | Deterministic NPV @ headline $M | Deterministic NPV @ market $M | MC mean $M | P10 | P50 | P90 | P(NPV>0) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ex1 heat pump, QC covered | +0.70 | +0.70 | +0.12 | -1.54 | +0.01 | +1.91 | 50% |
| Ex1 heat pump, BC covered | +1.37 | +0.66 | -0.13 | -2.01 | -0.26 | +1.91 | 43% |
| Ex1 heat pump, AB covered | -1.07 | -2.11 | -2.94 | -4.12 | -2.93 | -1.78 | 0% |
| Ex1 heat pump, ON covered | -1.99 | -2.44 | -3.32 | -4.95 | -3.37 | -1.63 | 1% |
| Ex3 AB abatement ($25M capex), merchant credits | - | - | -10.65 | -23.16 | -6.80 | -2.43 | 0% |
| Ex3 AB abatement ($25M capex), with $85 CCfD to 2040 | - | - | +2.46 | -1.83 | +2.65 | +6.29 | 76% |
